## Summary

Describe the user-facing or maintainer-facing change and link the related issue.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm run verify` passes.
- [ ] I built the affected Android variant when mobile or native behavior changed.
- [ ] UI changes include narrow and standard phone screenshots.
- [ ] New behavior has automated coverage or a clear testing explanation.

## Privacy and data

- [ ] Fixtures and screenshots use synthetic, public-domain, or compatibly licensed data.
- [ ] No credential, signing material, private document, employee data, or imported question bank is included.
- [ ] I described any change to local storage, model requests, logs, permissions, or network behavior.
- [ ] AI output still requires validation and human confirmation before saving.

## Documentation

- [ ] User-visible changes are documented in the README, relevant guide, and changelog.
- [ ] New user-facing strings are present in every supported locale.
